subject: Community Health
question: Name the 8 essential components of Primary Health Care (PHC) as defined by the Alma Ata Declaration.
answer: 1. Education on health problems. 2. Promotion of food supply and nutrition. 3. Adequate supply of safe water and basic sanitation. 4. Maternal and child health care (including family planning). 5. Immunization. 6. Prevention and control of local endemic diseases. 7. Appropriate treatment of common diseases and injuries. 8. Provision of essential drugs.
